report.summary: Both failures come from one root cause: the app accepts a publication year one past the current year (2027). The `year_off_by_one` seeded bug in `app/main.py` makes `validate_book` allow `this_year + 1`, so the API returns 201 instead of 422 and the UI saves the book instead of showing the error. Fix this first by confirming whether `BUGS=year_off_by_one` is set in the CI environment (the workflow doesn't set it) and disabling it or fixing the validation line, then rerun both suites.

causes.title: App accepts next year as a publication year
causes.explanation: validate_book computes max_year as this_year + 1 when the 'year_off_by_one' flag is in BUGS, so any year up to next year passes validation. Both tests send year = today + 1 and expect rejection with 'Year must be between'. The API test gets 201 Created. The UI test gets no error element because the book was saved; the table row shows 'Future-75f0a181 Someone 2027'. The app's own error message ('between 1 and {this_year}') confirms the intended limit is the current year. The behaviour is deterministic, so the tests are correct to fail while the flag is active.
evidence: tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:44: expect(books.error).to_contain_text("Year must be between") fails with 'Actual value: None / element(s) not found'
Aria snapshot in the UI failure shows row "Future-75f0a181 Someone 2027 Delete", so the book was saved
app/main.py:94: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year
app/main.py:95-96: if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
app/main.py:9: docstring lists 'year_off_by_one  accepts next year as a publication year' as a seeded bug

Test-side check: tests/api/test_books_api.py:58 and tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42 both compute today's year + 1 with date.today(), the same clock the app uses, so the test data is not the problem. The test_current_year_is_accepted test uses THIS_YEAR and is not failing.
causes.suggested_fix: Make validate_book reject years above this_year, i.e. remove the 'year_off_by_one' branch (max_year = date.today().year) so the seeded flag cannot change behaviour. Also check the CI runner environment and any .env files for BUGS=year_off_by_one. The workflow in .github/workflows/tests.yml does not set BUGS, so if the flag is set on the runner, unset it. If it is intentional seeded-bug mode, these two tests are correctly failing and should be marked as known failures rather than fixed in the tests.
